```{ojs}
// Find intersection points where betaPDF(x) = gamma using bisection
function findHDIBounds(gamma, alpha, beta, tol = 1e-6) {
  // First, find the mode of the distribution
  const mode = (alpha > 1 && beta > 1) 
    ? (alpha - 1) / (alpha + beta - 2) 
    : (alpha >= beta ? 0.99 : 0.01);
  
  const maxPDF = betaPDF(mode, alpha, beta);
  
  // If gamma is above the max, no valid HDI
  if (gamma >= maxPDF) {
    return { lower: mode, upper: mode, valid: false };
  }
  
  // If gamma is very small, return full interval
  if (gamma <= 1e-10) {
    return { lower: 0, upper: 1, valid: true };
  }
  
  // Find lower bound: search in [0, mode]
  let lo = 0, hi = mode;
  while (hi - lo > tol) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
    if (betaPDF(mid, alpha, beta) < gamma) {
      lo = mid;
    } else {
      hi = mid;
    }
  }
  const lower = (lo + hi) / 2;
  
  // Find upper bound: search in [mode, 1]
  lo = mode;
  hi = 1;
  while (hi - lo > tol) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
    if (betaPDF(mid, alpha, beta) > gamma) {
      lo = mid;
    } else {
      hi = mid;
    }
  }
  const upper = (lo + hi) / 2;
  
  return { lower, upper, valid: true };
}
```

```{ojs}
// Main HDI visualization
{
  const plotWidth = Math.min(960, Math.max(320, width));
  const height = 400;
  const marginTop = 40;
  const marginBottom = 60;
  const marginLeft = 60;
  const marginRight = 40;
  
  // Generate posterior PDF data
  const nPoints = 500;
  const xValues = d3.range(nPoints).map(i => i / (nPoints - 1));
  const pdfData = xValues.map(x => ({
    x: x,
    y: betaPDF(x, hdiAlpha, hdiBeta)
  }));
  
  // Calculate mode and max PDF value
  const mode = (hdiAlpha > 1 && hdiBeta > 1) 
    ? (hdiAlpha - 1) / (hdiAlpha + hdiBeta - 2) 
    : (hdiAlpha >= hdiBeta ? 0.99 : 0.01);
  const maxPDF = betaPDF(mode, hdiAlpha, hdiBeta);
  
  // Find HDI bounds for current gamma
  const hdiBounds = findHDIBounds(gammaLevel, hdiAlpha, hdiBeta);
  
  // Calculate the credible level (probability mass in HDI)
  const hdiProbability = hdiBounds.valid 
    ? betaCDF(hdiBounds.upper, hdiAlpha, hdiBeta) - betaCDF(hdiBounds.lower, hdiAlpha, hdiBeta)
    : 0;
  
  // Filter data for shaded HDI region
  const hdiData = pdfData.filter(d => 
    d.x >= hdiBounds.lower && d.x <= hdiBounds.upper && d.y >= gammaLevel
  );
  
  // Calculate posterior mean
  const posteriorMean = hdiAlpha / (hdiAlpha + hdiBeta);
  
  // Create the plot
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: plotWidth,
    height,
    marginTop,
    marginBottom,
    marginLeft,
    marginRight,
    style: {
      background: "var(--plot-bg)",
      color: "var(--plot-fg)",
      fontFamily: bodyFont,
      fontSize: 14
    },
    x: {
      label: "θ",
      domain: [0, 1],
      grid: false
    },
    y: {
      label: "Posterior density π(θ|x)",
      domain: [0, maxPDF * 1.15]
    },
    marks: [
      // Grid baseline
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "var(--plot-grid)", strokeOpacity: 0.6 }),
      
      // HDI shaded region
      Plot.areaY(hdiData, {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        y1: 0,
        fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
        fillOpacity: 0.35,
      }),
      
      // Posterior PDF curve
      Plot.lineY(pdfData, { 
        x: "x", 
        y: "y", 
        stroke: "currentColor", 
        strokeWidth: 2.5,
        strokeOpacity: 0.9
      }),
      
      // Horizontal gamma line
      Plot.ruleY([gammaLevel], {
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-2)",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "6,4"
      }),
      
      // Vertical lines at HDI bounds
      hdiBounds.valid ? Plot.ruleX([hdiBounds.lower], {
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        y1: 0,
        y2: gammaLevel
      }) : null,
      
      hdiBounds.valid ? Plot.ruleX([hdiBounds.upper], {
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        y1: 0,
        y2: gammaLevel
      }) : null,
      
      // Labels for bounds
      hdiBounds.valid ? Plot.text([{
        x: hdiBounds.lower,
        y: 0,
        text: hdiBounds.lower.toFixed(3)
      }], {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: "text",
        dy: 20,
        fontSize: 11,
        fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
        fontWeight: "600"
      }) : null,
      
      hdiBounds.valid ? Plot.text([{
        x: hdiBounds.upper,
        y: 0,
        text: hdiBounds.upper.toFixed(3)
      }], {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: "text",
        dy: 20,
        fontSize: 11,
        fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
        fontWeight: "600"
      }) : null,
      
      // Gamma label
      Plot.text([{
        x: 0.02,
        y: gammaLevel,
        text: `γ = ${gammaLevel.toFixed(2)}`
      }], {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: "text",
        dy: -8,
        dx: 5,
        fontSize: 12,
        fill: "var(--plot-series-2)",
        fontWeight: "600",
        textAnchor: "start"
      }),
      
      // HDI label
      hdiBounds.valid ? Plot.text([{
        x: (hdiBounds.lower + hdiBounds.upper) / 2,
        y: gammaLevel + (maxPDF - gammaLevel) * 0.5,
        text: "HDI"
      }], {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: "text",
        fontSize: 14,
        fontWeight: "bold",
        fill: "var(--plot-series-1)"
      }) : null
    ].filter(m => m !== null)
  });
  
  // Stats display
  const stats = html`
    <div style="margin-bottom: 15px; padding: 12px; background: var(--header-bg); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px;">
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px;">
        <div>
          <strong>Posterior:</strong> Beta(${hdiAlpha}, ${hdiBeta})
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong>Mode:</strong> ${mode.toFixed(3)}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong>γ threshold:</strong> ${gammaLevel.toFixed(3)}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style="color: var(--brand-teal);">Posterior mass in region:</strong> ${(hdiProbability * 100).toFixed(2)}%
        </div>
      </div>
      ${hdiBounds.valid ? html`
        <div style="margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);">
          <strong>HDI bounds:</strong> [${hdiBounds.lower.toFixed(4)}, ${hdiBounds.upper.toFixed(4)}]
          <span style="margin-left: 20px; color: var(--fg-muted);">
            Width: ${(hdiBounds.upper - hdiBounds.lower).toFixed(4)}
          </span>
        </div>
      ` : html`
        <div style="margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--brand-red);">
          <em>γ exceeds maximum density — no valid HDI region</em>
        </div>
      `}
    </div>
  `;
  
  return html`<div style="width: 100%; max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto;">
    ${stats}
    ${plot}
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Controls for HDI visualization
viewof hdiControls = {
  // Calculate initial max PDF for gamma slider range
  const initMode = (8 - 1) / (8 + 3 - 2);
  const initMaxPDF = betaPDF(initMode, 8, 3);
  
  const gammaSlider = Inputs.range([0, 4], { 
    value: 0.5, 
    step: 0.01, 
    label: tex`\gamma \text{ (density threshold)}` 
  });
  
  const betaAlphaSlider = Inputs.range([1, 30], { 
    value: 8, 
    step: 0.5, 
    label: tex`\text{Beta } \alpha \text{ parameter}` 
  });
  
  const betaBetaSlider = Inputs.range([1, 30], { 
    value: 3, 
    step: 0.5, 
    label: tex`\text{Beta } \beta \text{ parameter}` 
  });
  
  const root = html`<details class="controls-root" open>
    <summary style="cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;">HDI Controls</summary>
    <div class="controls-grid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:20px;padding:15px;">
      <div class="controls-col">
        <h4 style="margin-bottom: 10px;">Density Threshold</h4>
        ${gammaSlider}
        <div style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted);">
          <em>Adjust γ to see how the HDI region changes. The HDI contains all θ where π(θ|x) ≥ γ.</em>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="controls-col">
        <h4 style="margin-bottom: 10px;">Posterior Parameters</h4>
        ${betaAlphaSlider}
        <div style="margin-top: 15px;">
          ${betaBetaSlider}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </details>`;
  
  root.value = {
    gamma: gammaSlider.value,
    alpha: betaAlphaSlider.value,
    beta: betaBetaSlider.value
  };
  
  root.addEventListener("input", () => {
    root.value = {
      gamma: gammaSlider.value,
      alpha: betaAlphaSlider.value,
      beta: betaBetaSlider.value
    };
    root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  
  return root;
}

// Reactive bindings
gammaLevel = hdiControls.gamma
hdiAlpha = hdiControls.alpha
hdiBeta = hdiControls.beta
```
